land.label: Slideshow creators · Sophia
land.lead: As a **slideshow creator**, you post 2 slideshows a day on a TikTok account for **Sophia**, from your phone. Everything is prepared for you: the slides, the caption and the music. You assemble and publish.
anim.7: Paste the link in your dashboard
pay.label: Your pay
pay.title: A fixed amount every week
pay.lead: You are paid every Monday through Ruul. Your fixed weekly amount depends on your country: no follower or view target.
pay.resultNote: Paid every Monday through Ruul, for the posts of the week before.
pay.unavailable: No rate is available for this country yet.
do.label: The job
do.title: What you'll be doing
do.1.title: Your TikTok account
do.1: We give you a TikTok identity (name, photo, bio). You create the account on your phone and warm it up for a few days, exactly as we tell you. The account belongs to Sophia; you run it.
do.2.title: 2 slideshows a day
do.2: Every day, 2 slideshows are waiting for you in your dashboard. You post them on TikTok and paste the links. That's it: ==under 10 minutes a day==.
do.3.title: Nothing to invent
do.3: We give you the photos, the text and the music: you just copy, paste and publish. A simple way to earn extra money in a few minutes a day.
do.4.title: Help when you need it
do.4: Questions? Our team answers you on Slack and from your dashboard.
who.label: Who we're looking for
who.title: Simple, regular, from your phone
who.lead: People who want a simple, regular task they can do from their phone, and who follow instructions to the letter. **You don't appear on camera and you don't need any experience.**
who.criteria: Please do not apply if you don't meet these criteria:
crit.1: You are at least 18 years old
crit.2: You have a smartphone and a reliable internet connection
crit.3: You have a second phone you can use only for this work
crit.4: You can post 2 slideshows a day, 7 days a week
crit.5: You don't currently work for a competing app
crit.6: You agree to sign a short agreement before you start
why.label: Why Sophia
why.title: Why work with us?
why.1.title: A fixed amount every week
why.1: ==No follower or view target==: you know what you earn.
why.2.title: Everything is prepared
why.2: You never have to find ideas: the slides, caption and music are ready.
why.3.title: Whenever suits you
why.3: You work from anywhere, at the times that suit you during the day.
about.text: Sophia is a mobile learning app that helps people learn something new every day: history, mythology, art, literature, science and today's world. It is published by Vik Studios SAS, a French company.

ctr.label: Step 3 of 3
ctr.title: Your creator agreement
ctr.englishOnly: The agreement is in English. This is the version you sign.
ctr.a1: You start on {monday}. You post 2 slideshows a day.
ctr.a2: Your access: your dashboard opens right after you sign. Log in any time with your email.
ctr.a3: The job: everything is prepared for you. You download the pictures, add the text on TikTok and post. It takes about 5 minutes a slideshow.
ctr.a4: Your pay: every Monday, for the week before, through Ruul. You create a free Ruul account, verify your ID, and your pay goes to your bank account.
ctr.a5: Questions or stopping: ask anything from your dashboard. If you ever want to stop, just tell us, no hard feelings.
ctr.ruulHelp: The email you'll use for your Ruul account, where you get paid.
ctr.legalNameHelp: First and last name, exactly as on your ID. Typing it is your signature.
ctr.note: By clicking “I sign”, you sign this agreement electronically. We keep your legal name, the date, your IP address and your device as proof.

legal.title: Privacy and legal notice
legal.1: This site is published by Vik Studios SAS, a French company and the publisher of the Sophia app. Contact: support@vikstudios.com.
legal.2: Your application (name, email, WhatsApp number, country and answers) is stored by Vik Studios only to process it, contact you about it and, if you join, to manage your work and pay you. It is never sold.
legal.3: We only send you WhatsApp messages if you agreed to them. Reply STOP at any time to stop them.
legal.4: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data at any time by writing to us.
